reviewPassage:
Community Pizza Night
Kitchen notice for guests

Please bring dough that is ready to stretch. We have flour for dusting the boards, but not enough for everyone to make dough from scratch. If your dough was chilled, take it out ahead of time so it has a chance to soften. Dough that is already soft can go straight onto a board.

Put your first name on the handle of the board, not on the sheet beneath the pizza. The sheet goes into the oven; the board stays at the counter. The host will call names as the boards become available for reuse.

People usually wait near the oven. There will be a second waiting spot tonight for anyone who finds that area too warm. Follow the blue arrows to the benches by the entrance. The host will call the same names at both spots, so moving to the cooler area won’t affect your place in line. You are welcome to wait there until it’s your turn.

請在板子的握把上寫你的名，不必寫姓氏，不要寫在披薩下方的紙上。紙會進烤爐，板子留在櫃台。有板子空出來、可供使用時，主持人就會叫名字，讓下一位接著使用。

大家通常在烤爐附近等候。今晚另設一處等候區，讓覺得爐邊太熱的人使用。請沿藍色箭頭走到入口旁的長椅。主持人會在兩處叫同一批名字，所以移到涼一點的地方不會改變排隊順序。輪到你之前，歡迎在那裡等候。
